welcome: Welcome, warrior. I'm Alexei, head coach of the Taiga Wolf camp. Here we train the body, the breath and the will. Every technique is practised slowly and safely, with a partner and an instructor. Are you ready? Let's go into camp!
gate: Before you train, remember: warm up properly, train on mats, and work with a partner and a qualified instructor. If anything hurts, stop at once. If you agree, please confirm below.
home_1: Welcome back, warrior. What shall we train today?
home_2: Discipline means doing what needs doing, even when you don't feel like it. Let's train.
home_3: Fifteen minutes a day. In a month, you won't recognise yourself.
home_4: The forest waits for no one. Warm up, and we'll begin.
home_streak: Your training streak is still going. Don't let it break.
home_done: You've finished the whole Close-Combat Self-Defence track. Review it every day. Real skill lives in repetition.
track_tay-khong: The Close-Combat Self-Defence track. Eight foundation lessons and seven advanced ones, from breathing to escaping on the ground. Go in order. Don't skip ahead.
track_the-luc: The Fitness and Survival track: load carrying, swimming, finding water, fire and shelter. This track is still being prepared.
track_ban-sung: The Sport Shooting track. Safety comes first. This track is still being prepared.
lesson_locked: This lesson isn't open yet. Finish the previous one first.
practice_intro: Train with me. I'll count for you.
quiz_intro: Quick quiz. Four questions. Answer correctly to earn experience points.
right_3: Spot on. You remember the lesson very well.
wrong_1: Not quite. Listen to the explanation.
wrong_2: That's wrong, but it's fine. We learn from our mistakes.
wrong_3: Not correct. Let's look at it again.
quiz_retry: Not a pass yet. Go over the lesson and try again. Nobody is good from the start.
rank_up: Congratulations! You've been promoted. Keep up the good work.
badge: You've just earned a new badge.
profile: This is your warrior profile: your rank, your badges and your training streak.
plan: Today's plan is ready. Complete it to keep your streak going.
plan_done: Today's plan is done. Rest, drink some water, and I'll see you tomorrow.
drill_reps_done: That's all your reps. Very good!
track_ngu-trang: The Camouflage and Concealment track: ghillie suits, face paint, moving silently and covering your tracks. This track is still being prepared.
track_dong-doi: The Teamwork track: hand signals, communication and moving as a team. Opening soon.
track_so-cuu: The Battlefield First Aid track: stopping bleeding, applying a tourniquet, and CPR. These skills can save a life. Opening soon.
track_tam-ly: The Mental Toughness track: staying calm, controlling fear, and sharpening your observation. Opening soon.
exam_intro: The track final exam. Ten questions drawn from every lesson you've learnt. Eight or more correct is a pass. Stay calm, and read each question carefully.
exam_pass: Outstanding! You've graduated from the Close-Combat Self-Defence track. From today, you are a Steel Wolf of the Taiga Wolf camp.
exam_fail: Not a pass this time. Review your weaker lessons, then take the exam again. Steel is tempered in fire many times over.
exam_locked: Complete all fifteen lessons of the track to unlock the final exam.
next_step: Well done. On to the next step.
lesson_end_auto: That's the end of the session. Remember to do your homework. Now let's have a quick quiz to see how much you remember.
auto_off: Switched to manual mode. You tap to go to the next step.
auto_on: Auto-coach is on. All you need to do is train with me.
